## [3.105.1] - 2026-11-05

### Bug Fixes

- retain a non-null catalog lookup callback
- require local catalog products before returns
- limit checkout PR to cash rounding order
- preserve native retail totals and partial refund evidence
- align nearest cash rounding with payable currency totals
- preserve valid cash denominations at rounding boundaries
- identify each affected sale line
- report specific refund preparation failures

### Other Changes

- provide catalog fixtures for valid refund flows
- record retail verification and backend dependency
- cover video cash tender and change sequence
- record final nearest cash checkout verification
- capture messages in the full Nexo app
